label: IP Rating
description: Ingress Protection rating of the LED luminaire shall be IP66 or higher to provide protection against dust and powerful water jets.

label: Warranty
description: The LED street luminaire shall have a minimum warranty period of two years or more for free replacement.

label: Lumen Efficacy
description: The luminaire system efficacy shall be greater than or equal to 100 lumen per watt.

label: Voltage Range
description: The LED luminaire shall operate within an input voltage range of 140 to 270 VAC at 50 Hz.

label: Power Factor
description: The power factor of the LED driver shall be greater than or equal to 0.95.

label: Impact Resistance Rating
description: The luminaire enclosure shall comply with IK08 impact resistance protection.

label: Surge Protection
description: The LED luminaire driver shall provide surge protection of at least 10 kV.
